meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 GitHub 项目里积压的问题详情和讨论都读完,按根本原因归成几组,每组建一个主问题、配设计文档,并用统一留言关闭子问题;之后新问题也会记录到对应主问题下,最终用一个修复 PR 批量关闭整组。
howto.when: 当仓库积压 20 个以上相似问题,或你要求做归类、去重、做计划等,或想判断新 bug 是否属于已有工作,或想把多个子问题用一个 PR 关掉时触发;少于约 15 个则不触发。

say.text: 把这 100 个 issue 按根本原因聚成几组,每组开一个主 issue。
say.note: 会读全部问题和评论,按根因分组开主问题。

say.text: 这个新 bug 该归到哪个计划?按流程处理。
say.note: 会匹配对应主计划,发 Round N 评论后关闭子问题。

say.text: 把计划 02 的修复做成一个 PR,合并时自动关掉所有子 issue。
say.note: PR 里会列出每个子问题对应的 Closes 编号。

howto.what_en: Reads every issue in full, clusters a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into plan masters, closes children via a standard redirect, ships one PR per cluster closing it atomically. New bugs land on the matching master as Round N comments.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 20+ open issues, when asked to triage/dedupe issues or plan from them, when routing a new bug into existing work, or when shipping one PR that closes an issue cluster. Skip under ~15.

say_en.text: Group these 100 issues by root cause and open one master issue per cluster.
say_en.note: Reads all issues and comments, then opens plan masters.

say_en.text: Which plan does this new bug belong to? Process it accordingly.
say_en.note: Matches a master, posts Round N, then closes the child.

say_en.text: Ship the fix for plan 02 as one PR, auto-closing all its children on merge.
say_en.note: PR body lists every child with Closes #N.
